items.label: Modular Packaging Design
items.value: For optimal protection and handling, this sectional sofa is divided into 4 parcels. The cloud sectional couch may arrive at slightly different intervals to ensure each section reaches you in pristine condition. Your satisfaction is our priority throughout your home furnishing journey.

items.label: Zero Assembly, Instant Comfort
items.value: Unpack and use right away—no tools or setup needed! This modular sectional sofa arrives ready for your living room, apartment, or small space, saving you time and hassle while delivering immediate relaxation. Complete revival may take up to around 72 hours.

items.label: SmartS Coil Support for All Body Types
items.value: Experience 10% better pressure relief and support with our high-compression SmartS Coil springs. They adapt to your weight, reduce fatigue, and enhance durability—perfect for families, couples, or solo lounging.

items.label: Soft, Safe, and Stress-Free
items.value: This durable, wrinkle-resistant corduroy sofa is built for real life. With OEKO-TEX certified textiles and CertiPUR-US certified foam, you get ultra-soft comfort and peace of mind in one. It’s the ultimate family-friendly upgrade—standing up to heavy play while maintaining its smooth, luxurious look.

items.label: Lightweight & Modular Design
items.value: With 16% lighter smart weight distribution, the modular sectional sofa is easy to move and reconfigure. Its modular blueprint allows breezy navigation through snug corridors and tight entrances—ideal for renters or frequent rearrangers.
